sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Surveys offer a non-intimidating environment which leads more likely to honest and open responses, uncovering answers that might not come up in other settings. They provide a good base to compare results and base decisions on objective information. OCM survey purposes include: customer satisfaction (about communications or training), feedback on needs and wishes, change and KPI monitoring (change readiness, change success), and pulse & mood barometer feedback.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves stakeholder satisfaction and trust. Enables data-driven change management. Supports agile response to challenges. Enhances effectiveness of change interventions. Builds a culture of openness and continuous improvement.

sections.heading: Related Guidelines & Tools
items: Surveys can be conducted anonymously or personalized, online or on paper
MS Forms (part of M365) — allows creating surveys and quizzes with Excel export
